candidates.name: Josh Green
candidates.basis: Signed abortion-access and sensitive-places gun laws; expanded tax credits; state-funded ACA subsidies; carbon-negative goal while proposing an LNG import facility.

candidates.name: Gary Cordery
candidates.basis: Proposes tax and government cuts, work-linked aid, vouchers and merit pay; questions the Green Fee; names the Bible as his political philosophy.

candidates.name: Jim Risch
candidates.basis: Voted for OBBBA, FISA renewal, Laken Riley Act, 2024 Ukraine aid, KOSA; against Respect for Marriage and gun-safety acts; opposes abortion; backs nuclear power.

candidates.name: Todd Achilles
candidates.basis: Backs antitrust, repealing right-to-work, data privacy, Big Tech accountability, abortion-rights initiative, gun rights, border security with immigration reform; opposes endless wars.

candidates.name: Brad Little
candidates.basis: Signed six-week abortion ban, trans sports ban, law blocking federal gun orders; opposes marijuana legalization; cut regulations, taxes; border missions; school choice, teacher raises.

photo.author: Phil White/Office of the Governor of Idaho

candidates.name: Terri Pickens
candidates.basis: Supports unions and living wage, accessible health care, clean energy, repealing vouchers, abortion and LGBTQ rights, humane immigration; says religion should not shape law.

candidates.name: John Stegner
candidates.basis: Wants to restore Medicaid access, undo the school voucher law, require warrants for Flock camera data, and make data centers prove community benefit.

candidates.name: Juliana Stratton
candidates.basis: Backs Medicare for All, $25 minimum wage, millionaire tax, abolishing ICE, abortion and LGBTQ rights, gun safety laws, AI regulation; opposes Iran war.

candidates.name: Don Tracy
candidates.basis: Favors spending and regulation cuts, targeted tariffs, all-of-the-above energy, border security, police, China deterrence, no benefits for non-citizens; opposes transgender girls in girls' sports.

candidates.name: JB Pritzker
candidates.basis: Signed $15 minimum wage, abortion protections, cannabis legalization, assault weapons ban, cash-bail repeal, clean-energy mandate, AI safety audits, ICE cooperation limits; expanded preschool.

candidates.name: Darren Bailey
candidates.basis: Wants lower property and income taxes, spending cuts, tougher policing, fully funded schools with parental choice; opposes SAFE-T Act, abortion and gun control.

photo.file: File:Darren Bailey at a 2022 Campaign Event (cropped).jpg
photo.author: Cobiblair

candidates.name: Ashley Hinson
candidates.basis: Voted for OBBBA, Laken Riley, FISA extension, Ukraine aid, TikTok divestment, Born-Alive and Respect for Marriage acts; against background checks; backs E15.

candidates.name: Josh Turek
candidates.basis: Backs a public option, PRO Act, indexed minimum wage, food price-gouging ban, ending vouchers, codifying Roe, marriage equality, simpler citizenship path; opposes unnecessary wars.

candidates.name: Rob Sand
candidates.basis: Proposes under-16 social media ban, data center rules, higher minimum wage, ending Medicaid privatization, legal cannabis, universal pre-K, voucher limits, renewables, prison for taxpayer theft.

candidates.name: Zach Lahn
candidates.basis: Backs total abortion ban, constitutional carry, ESA expansion, no benefits for unauthorized immigrants, farm antitrust suits, data center moratorium, privatized Medicaid, revoking indoctrinating teachers' licenses.

candidates.name: Roger Marshall
candidates.basis: Voted for OBBBA, KOSA, Laken Riley Act; against 2024 Ukraine aid, FISA renewal, gun-safety and marriage acts; backs tariffs, wall, all-of-the-above energy; opposes abortion.

candidates.name: Adam Hamilton
candidates.basis: Backs reversing Medicaid cuts, restoring ACA credits, broader Medicare drug negotiation, ending tariffs and Iran war, union bargaining, abortion rights, all-of-the-above energy, AI hiring safeguards.

photo.author: Western Pennsylvania Conference - United Methodist Church

candidates.name: Cindy Holscher
candidates.basis: Backs Medicaid expansion, $16 minimum wage, repealing right-to-work, paid sick leave, cannabis legalization, data center moratorium, public school funding over vouchers; opposed immigrant detention facility.

candidates.name: Ty Masterson
candidates.basis: Led $2 billion tax cut; backs private school vouchers, police funding, data center tax incentives; opposes abortion rights, gender surgeries for minors, illegal immigration.
